fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Accounting.FinanceExceptions.Clear
fields.Description: Clear an Open finance exception as Reviewed or Corrected through Accounting.ClearFinanceException. Held by the Finance role. The default right: it decides only for a type whose MJ.BizApps.Accounting.FinanceExceptions.ClearType.<CODE> right is granted to no role, and only when the creator is not unattributed or escalated under a granted ClearUnattributed / EscalatedCreator + ClearEscalated right. The operation still refuses the source record's creator, so holding this does not let anyone clear an exception raised on their own work.
